description: This source file contains test cases for the 'codex-native-web-search' module, which provides functionality related to resolving activation states, configuring web search tools, and managing search payloads within a Codex native web search context. It includes tests for configuration normalization, payload injection, and relevance determination.

methods.name: buildCodexNativeWebSearchTool
methods.description: Builds a web search tool configuration object based on provided web search settings.

methods.name: describeCodexNativeWebSearch
methods.description: Provides a description or summary of the current web search configuration or payload.

methods.name: patchCodexNativeWebSearchPayload
methods.description: Injects a native web search payload into existing tool configurations if not already present.

methods.name: resolveCodexNativeSearchActivation
methods.description: Determines whether Codex native web search is active, disabled, or managed-only based on configuration and model provider info.

methods.name: resolveCodexNativeWebSearchConfig
methods.description: Normalizes and consolidates configuration options for native web search, including allowed domains, context size, and user location.

methods.name: shouldSuppressManagedWebSearchTool
methods.description: Decides if the managed web search tool should be suppressed based on whether a native Codex search is active.

methods.name: isCodexNativeWebSearchRelevant
methods.description: Checks if a given model/provider setup is relevant for native web search functionality.

ctags.name: payload
ctags.pattern: /^    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { tools: [{ type: "function", name: "read" }] };$/

ctags.name: payload
ctags.pattern: /^    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { tools: [{ type: "web_search" }] };$/

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^    const result = patchCodexNativeWebSearchPayload({ payload, config: baseConfig });$/
